d: Amber wants to put an end to the fighting and move away from Gary. Farrah can't stand living under her parents' roof anymore. Maci struggles to keep up in school when her son starts walking. Catelyn and Tyler plan their future.

Catelynn & Tyler work on letting go of Carly, & Tyler works up the nerve to propose marriage to Catelynn. Maci and Ryan celebrate Bentley's first birthday. Amber copes with the pressures while planning Leah's 1st birthday.
Sam and Chloe's relationship comes under scrutiny from Nathan, causing friction in the house. Will this divide help Nathan and Chloe's bond and allow Sam to get to know the new housemates? (S17, ep3)
Half the gang head off to Byron Bay leaving the rest wondering where they are! Chloe is going out of her mind without Sam whilst Abbie is trying to work out if Grant is the lad for her. (S17, ep4)
Heidi loves her single life, until seeing Spencer with other girls makes her jealous.
With Spencer out of the picture, Heidi makes a last attempt to regain Lauren's friendship.

After hiding her pregnancy for eight months, Izabella is forced to reconsider who her true friends are. This young mom then risks her family ties when the boyfriend she brought into her family's house betrays their trust.

With an immature boyfriend and distant parents, Kianna wants more stability for her baby and considers adoption. When no one supports her decision, she and boyfriend Zak need to figure out how to be successful parents together.

Taylor's mom wants her to choose adoption, but Taylor and her boyfriend Nathan feel that they can be good teen parents. But when Nathan disappoints Taylor as they prepare for parenthood, she begins to question her decision.
After moving in with her boyfriend's dysfunctional family, Allie needs to decide whether to raise her baby in an unstable environment or without a dad.

Amber and Gary's arguing finally reaches a boiling point, while Catelynn struggles to find a home when her mother moves away. Newly-single mom Maci has a change of heart, and boy-crazy Farrah opts for some protection.

Catelyn chooses adoption during a weekend retreat with other birth moms, while Maci and Ryan reach out to a counselor. Amber thinks about accepting help from her ex, and Farrah wonders if she should stay home more with her baby.
